name: single_button
description: One isolated medium rectangle - should detect exactly one button.

name: single_input
description: One long thin rectangle - should detect exactly one text input.

name: single_dropdown
description: An input-shaped rectangle with a small triangle marker near its right edge - should detect exactly one dropdown, not a plain input.

name: single_checkbox
description: One small square - should detect exactly one checkbox.

name: single_radio
description: One circle - should detect exactly one radio button.

name: nested_login_card
description: A card containing two inputs, a checkbox, a radio, and a button - tests both detection AND containment nesting.

name: table_grid
description: A 4x3 grid of small rectangles - should collapse into a single table component.

name: row_of_buttons
description: Three buttons in a single row - a false-positive check: this should NOT become a table (grid detection requires >=2 rows).

name: pure_scribble
description: An irregular open freehand scribble with no closed UI shape - should be promoted to a standalone SVG shape (not silently dropped, not misclassified as a UI component).

name: mixed_with_scribble
description: One valid button plus one irregular scribble - tests that valid shapes are still found alongside a standalone shape promoted to SVG.

name: right_arrow
description: A hand-drawn right-pointing arrow - must NOT be classified as button/checkbox/radio/table; should render as an SVG outline.

name: star_shape
description: A 5-pointed star outline - must NOT be classified as any UI component; should render as a closed SVG outline.
